name: Bünde (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and green, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Bünde (two men shaking hands on red).
history: Together with the arms, a hoisted flag and a banner were granted in 1972; the arms lie on the white stripe, shifted towards the hoist on the flag and in the upper third of the banner.

features.role: Bünde arms — two men shaking hands on red
